notes.title: QUEEN OF MOTHS
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671547/74c4342f22ea1b03bcf111c653892ef4bf729696.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434490/Queen_of_Moths/

Our game, Queen of Moths, has just been released!
This is something for fans of surreal, cosmic horror.

[previewyoutube=eQqFyrscKxw;full][/previewyoutube]

It's a winter night. You're returning home by train. It's been a long time since you've been there. You just have to transfer to another train. Just a moment's wait at a small train station in the middle of the forest.

You're familiar with this - it's not the first time you've traveled this route. However, this time, a strange uneasiness accompanies you. Something is different. Something is not right.



Safe journey!
Tesseract Games team

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1]

Welcome to another devlog! In the upcoming posts, we'll introduce you to your future crew. After all, it's good to know who you're venturing into space with, right? You'll steer the fates of these individuals in Project: Aurora!

Each crew member is unique. Their skills, choices, and relationships will shape the story and mission success.

Get ready for characters full of passion and mysteries, guiding your expedition on an alien planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671547/b3bb761dcc53ace2791188eade840c1ded73b6cb.png[/img]
[b]JOHN MCDONNEL[/b]
[i]A chemistry doctor and author of numerous scientific works in the field of nuclear chemistry and astrochemistry. He interrupted his scientific career at the age of 41 to join the Yamada Exploration Corp. Currently serving as a specialist chemist during exploratory missions. He has spent 23 standard years with the company so far and is currently on his 5th contract. He is highly regarded by colleagues for his exceptionally cheerful disposition and immense patience. During brief stays on Earth, he often gives guest lectures. Occasionally, he publishes in industry journals, and recently authored a popular science book on the significance of chemical research in modern space exploration.[/i]


Safe journey!
Project: Aurora team

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1]

The latest demo update has just been released! This time, we had to focus mainly on bug fixes. Some of them took us by surprise and required a lot of work, but, finally, we managed to solve! Thank you for all your feedback, support and help.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Pressing the "Tab" key at the start of the game will no longer lock the controls.
- The tutorial system has been improved.
- We fixed tutorial bugs that were blocking gameplay in some cases.
- GUI improvements have been made.
- The research outpost handling system has been completely rebuilt.

Safe journey!
Project: Aurora team

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1]

Creating an alien world has been (and still is) one of our greatest challenges. After all, as a reference and inspiration, we only have one technologically advanced civilization that actually exists - the one on Earth. So how do we develop a world filled with the ruins of a completely alien civilization?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671547/1f69419f8d46cefd53ae3c938069aa4e2a681299.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671547/dd7af57cb8577ccbcfc6f83b4e68da45b122d440.png[/img]

We worked on it step by step. First, we had to answer the question: what beings created this civilization? What did they look like? How did they live? How did they think? What did their daily lives look like? We had to find answers to each of these questions (and many others). For obvious reasons, we won't provide those answers here - you'll discover them for yourself during the game ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671547/dd7af57cb8577ccbcfc6f83b4e68da45b122d440.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671547/a358790c8c9cbc5ca9655f47e83a94ee065520d1.png[/img]

Then, we had to imagine how this civilization evolved - from ancient times to its peak of development. And finally, we had to trace its downfall and destruction.

In the game, you will see the ruins that are the result of this process. But not only that! You will also explore other aspects of the past life on Aurora and its numerous secrets.

Safe journey!
Project: Aurora team

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1]

Recently, we focused on a few important improvements in our game. We improved the building system in the base. Now, the crates lying around everywhere won't hinder your movement when you're near the space shuttle! We also improved the navigation. It's a small change, but it can make a big difference, especially during longer journeys into the depths of the Aurora deserts. We added a few visual effects that improve the overall look of the game. Additionally, we supplemented the location assets to introduce even more details and variety to the game world.

We're very pleased with the results of our work and can't wait for you to experience them during your expeditions! Take care, and see you during the missions!

Safe journey!
Project: Aurora team
